Note.text: Site visit to Harrow Street. The second location on Lantern Row has signed heads of terms; Priya wants to open before the spring. Tom will run the second site day to day. Wholesale now a third of sales.
Annual review. Priya (58) is thinking about succession in five years; Tom would take over. Strong wholesale pipeline with three cafes signed this quarter.
The practice added a third chair in July; the waiting list is six weeks. Equipment quotes attached to the application.
The fraud team placed a block on the operating account in June after counterfeit cheque deposits. KYC refresh requested twice; no response from the director.
Mossbank Mill lease signed 2026-09-20, ten years with a break at five. Founder memberships pre-sold: 412 at the visit, target 600 before opening. Original gym at capacity on weekday evenings.
Membership growth steady through the year. One payment on the fit-out loan went in a week late in August while the card terminal was replaced; nothing since.
Alder Logistics missed the July and August payments. Tom Alder says two large customers are paying late. Collections engaged; no arrangement agreed yet.
Maureen Pell wants three fitted vans for the new county maintenance contract; the current fleet is two vans at end of life. Contract runs three years.
Wrenfield Mechanical on plan; Maureen Pell holds a minority stake and sits on the board. KYC refresh scheduled for Q4.
